title: Easy on the eye: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 61
content:
## Easy on the eye

**Word Power 61 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Pleasant to look at.

### Usage

1. Her paintings are very easy on the eye.
2. I like your colour scheme in this room. It's easy on the eye.

### How to use it

Easy on the eye means visually pleasant. It can describe a layout, colour scheme, building or person. It is informal; when speaking about people, consider whether a comment on appearance is appropriate.

### Another example

The notebook's clear spacing and soft colours make the page easy on the eye.

### Check your understanding

Choose: This page is easy ___ the eye. (on / for)

### Suggested answer

On. Keep the fixed expression easy on the eye. It comments on appearance rather than the difficulty of the lesson.
